newsitem.title: POLAND: GUINNESS , FINLAND FIRM IN POLISH VENTURE.
newsitem.headline: GUINNESS , FINLAND FIRM IN POLISH VENTURE.

text.p: The Polish spirits arm of Guinness PLC, United Distillers Polska, and Primalco & Havistra, part of Finland's Alko Group Ltd, will form a joint venture to market, distribute and produce spirits in Poland, the company said.

The new company, called United Distillers Finlandia Group, also signed an agreement with Primalco, to make international brands of spirits at the Polmos Zyrardow distillery, in which Primalco has already invested 15 million markka, the firm said in a statment.
The new firm will be operational by mid-year.
